name: AFR 113 左发失效 乘客中风

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 113, you're holding at holding point Echo 1, runway 04, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Air France 113，你在 Echo 1 等待点，跑道 04，已完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR113, holding at holding point E1, runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR113，在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 113, hold at present position.

C: Air France 113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
B: Tell the controller yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air France 113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边航空器了吗？
B：告诉管制员看到了。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 113, behind the China Eastern 737 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，跟在短五边的 China Eastern 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind the CES737 on short final, line up behind, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CES737 后面，跟随其后进跑道，AFR113。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2，AFR113。

cards.audioText: B: You are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID and proceed to Lima Kilo Oscar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消 SID 并直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR113, passing 900 meters, request cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR113，正通过 900 米，请求取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 113, radar identified, continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to Lima Kilo Oscar.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，雷达识别，继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 Lima Kilo Oscar。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to LKO, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 LKO，AFR113。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 113, climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Air France 113，爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7，AFR113。

cards.audioText: B: Your position is just over Lima Kilo Oscar, the next waypoint is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的位置刚好在 Lima Kilo Oscar 上空，下一个航路点是 DAPRO，预计到达时间 34，做标准位置报告并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR113, over LKO, ETA DAPRO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR113，飞越 LKO，预计 DAPRO 34，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 113, climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 113，爬升至5100米，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction, AFR113.

cards.audioText: B: During the climb, your port engine fails, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中左发失效，请向管制员报告情况并申请返航着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR113, our port engine fails, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR113，我们左发失效，申请返航着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Roger PAN, Air France 113, descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到紧急信号，Air France 113，下降至1800米，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360, AFR113.

cards.audioText: B: Your altitude is 1800 meters, you have information Sierra, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前高度1800米，已收到通播Sierra，请联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, 1800 meters, information S.

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 113, current information is Tango, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 36L.
B: Read back and ask to use runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 113，当前通播为Tango，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36左跑道。请复诵，并因性能限制申请使用36右跑道落地。
cards.referenceText: Information T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 36L, request runway 36R due performance, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播T，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36L；因性能限制申请36R，AFR113。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 113, change landing runway 36R.
B: You have just got the information from the cabin that 1 of your passengers suffered a stroke during the incident, informed the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 113，改为36右跑道落地。你刚从客舱获知，一名旅客在事件中突发中风，请通知管制员并申请落地后救护车保障。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, 1 of our passengers suffered stroke, request ambulance after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR113，我们有一名旅客中风，申请落地后救护车保障。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Air France 113, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，Air France 113，我们会通知机场医疗保障。现在左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36右跑道。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36R，AFR113。

cards.audioText: B: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已截获36右跑道航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, established on the localizer runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR113，已建立36R航向道。
